notes.title: Update 1.0.0 is out!
notes.content:
[h1]Hello SLI-FI community![/h1]

We are happy to announce that we finally released our game after three years of early access hell.
I have to apologize to everyone that waited for years to play [b]World 4[/b]...

The game started development four years ago and got released into early access one year later.
We just were two school friends that wanted to make a game. One Coder and one Designer. Unfortunately when we left school and started getting jobs three years ago, we kind of lost track of each other.

So here we are, three years later. I just had to finally finish this game because I didn't want to be one of those devs that lets his game die before it even releases.

World 4 is finally there and achievements for it also exist!
Also, I made a lot of small bugfixes. Previously you could get stuck on some planets or bounce weirdly on the pudding planet.

[h2]I hope everyone enjoys World 4! ːsteamhappyː [/h2]

notes.title: Full Controller Support!
notes.content:
We finally got full controller support!
No mouse or keyboard is needed anymore if you want to play on your couch :)

notes.title: Skin Update!
notes.content:
As Halloween is coming we are releasing Player Skins! Currently only 2 Skins exist but more will come soon.

To get the Halloween exclusive Skin, you have to be logged into the game some time around Halloween (From 27 October to 3rd of November).
If you logged in at this time, you will get the Skin and you can use it forever!

Have fun with the Skins and stay tuned for more!

notes.title: Early Access is here!
notes.content:
[b]Dear Gamers[/b],
SLI-FI is finally in Early Access!
Thank you for all the great support from interested users. Now the real development starts! We will improve the game from now on with your ideas! 

Make sure to check SLI-FI out now and stay excited for coming updates like more levels and a level editor!
